svg.title: AJ Motors - API Contract Responses (implemented response shapes)

g.text: AJ Motors - API Contract Responses (implemented response shapes)
Errors: POST 400/409; GET list 400; GET item 400/404;
Lists currently contain full snapshots, not reduced summaries.
status : PENDING | RESERVING | RESERVED | PAYMENT_PENDING | REVIEW_REQUIRED
POST /orders -> 201 PENDING; null amount/currency until reserved
status : REQUESTED | PENDING | REJECTED | COMPLETED | FAILED
paidAt : ISO-8601 UTC LocalDateTime or null
409 duplicate or disallowed transition; 503 dependency outage.
Internal SQL IDs are never included in public DTOs.
Endpoint paths in notes are prefixed with /api/v1.
Internal product projection PUT: 204 after stored/obsolete version.
/health: 200 UP or 503 DOWN for local dependencies.
Gateway/frontend health concerns their own process.
Six backend services and Keycloak are checked.
AI does not persist text; user approves a normal product write.
Invalid input/output or model timeout returns a JSON error.
GraphQL response: data and optional errors.
Query errors are distinct from HTTP authentication errors.
REST errors retain status/message; 401/403 protect role/ownership.
Confirmation GET: application/pdf; missing document is not a blank PDF.
